acceptance: polars-2-compat runs on every develop push (trunk.yml) or nightly, or on every PR touching DataFrame paths.
A workflow test pins where it runs.
context: Found in the 2026-10-09 tracker review. Other jobs that left the queue are covered elsewhere (plan-capture-gate is fast-marked; DataFusion tests are slow-marked and run in the release canary; binary framing runs in nightly.yml:201 and on test-infrastructure PRs).
description:
polars-2-compat (ci.yml:1061-1091, added by #2771) runs only when heavy_tier_needed.py says the heavy tier is needed, which on a pull request is only for soundness or packaging changes. Since the merge queue was retired (#2582) no trunk.yml, nightly or release-canary job runs it, so a routine PR can break Polars 2 with no signal.

Add the job to trunk.yml (or a nightly-v2 domain), or run it on every PR that touches DataFrame code.
